title: pvTimeSource
body:
## pvTimeSource

Test source with time: an unstructured grid of one unit voxel cell (or a column of voxels along y that grows and shrinks over time when Growing is on) carrying "Point Value" and "Cell Value" arrays equal to sin(2πt) plus label and coordinate arrays, over the time range 0 to 1 with ten discrete steps. XAmplitude and YAmplitude move the cell along a sine path over time. Use it to check time handling ($time, animation, temporal filters) without a real case.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The native description calls the output a uniform grid; VTK actually produces a vtkUnstructuredGrid.
- With Analytic false only the ten steps 0, 1/9, …, 1 exist and other requested times snap to the previous step; enable Analytic for continuous values.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `TimeSource`. Identity: `sources/TimeSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Analytic` | Makes the time source produce discrete steps of or an analytic sin wave. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Growing` | Makes the time source grow and shrink along Y over time. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `XAmplitude` | Controls how far the data set moves along X over time. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `YAmplitude` | Controls how far the data set moves along Y over time. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

```json
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```
